statement: Axeyum checks the Chapter 11 A0 clear-register pair under result-only and full-state observations, returning canonical decoded-state counterexamples that replay through both encoded programs.
scope: Width eight; one-instruction movi-r0-zero and xor-r0-r0-r0 programs; all 256 r0 values and all 16 initial Z/N/C/V assignments for the unrestricted family; empty memory, r1 through r7 zero, pc zero, running outcome, and a one-step bound.
exclusions: A solver certificate or width-parametric theorem

checker.expected_result: a0-equivalence: PASS: result-only=4096 full-with-premise=256 counterexamples=2 replayed=2

negative_control.mutates: Write XOR's result to r1 instead of the observed r0 and require a decoded replayed r0 witness

limitations: Equivalent verdicts are exhaustive only over the declared finite state families.
The checker uses concrete A0 execution rather than a separately checked unsatisfiability certificate.
A separate tested control corrupts a saved model byte and requires replay rejection, but the manifest has one load-bearing negative-control command.
